note: Secret NAMES the production Worker needs, never values. A new version of this Worker copies its secrets from the NEWEST uploaded version, not from the deployed one, and branch builds upload versions here. Run `npm run check:release` before and after every production release. test/release-secrets.test.js keeps this list in step with src/.

required.RESEND_API_KEY: newsletter and signup mail through Resend (src/newsletter.js, src/index.js)
required.GMAIL_CLIENT_ID: mail sent through Gmail; production runs MAIL_TRANSPORT=gmail (src/mail-transport.js)

do_not_set.BETA_AUTH_SIGNING_KEY: Faisal, Nov 11: beta testers do not get their own signing key. Leave it unset so src/beta-access.js signs beta sessions with ADMIN_AUTH_SIGNING_KEY.

retired.AIRTABLE_TOKEN: no longer read anywhere in src/
retired.BEEHIIV_API_KEY: no longer read anywhere in src/ (newsletters moved to Resend)
